title.zh: 自动驾驶软件商Applied Intuition估值拟翻倍至300亿美元，或融资至少10亿美元

current_state.zh: Autonomous driving software company Applied Intuition has reportedly received multiple funding offers valuing it at no less than $30 billion — double its June valuation — and expects to raise at least $1 billion in the coming months.
